localEntities.label: conventional versus unconventional war
localEntities.description: The strategic choice between relying on superior mass, resources and set-piece battle, and relying on speed, manoeuvre, deception or indirect approaches.

localEntities.label: East-West contest for the Roman Empire
localEntities.description: The question whether the Roman state's centre of power would lie in the Greek East or the Latin West.
